observed.fact: SHOW FULL COLUMNS displays the registered supplementary default as a replacement question mark on permanent tables and on the MySQL 5.6 temporary table. On MySQL 8.4 the temporary metadata displays the original UTF-8 bytes as uppercase hexadecimal. A native insert reads the original Unicode value from both table namespaces.

rule: Compare the exact raw Default metadata in all phases. Expect the native uppercase 0xF09090B7 display for the registered supplementary literal on a modern temporary table and the exact question mark display on the legacy temporary and persistent cases. Compare actual default insertion bytes independently in both namespaces.
preserves: All scheduled cases, finite coordinates and seeds, and both the raw metadata and typed inserted values. Any different raw display or default value fails its own comparison.
control: Keep the raw Default metadata unchanged while replacing the inserted supplementary value. Reject the resulting observation.
